exact.Allumer, sur le FM-1, lance le son et le: Power on, on the FM-1, starts the sound and the chosen firmware; the switch under the FM-1 does too. Powering off with the switch resets the active firmware to factory settings (its presets, patterns and settings are erased), then reloads the page.
exact.Le bouton Firmware ouvre la liste : d'ab: The Firmware button opens the list: first the optimised ones (FM-1+VA and the firmwares compiled for the browser), then the emulated ones, which run the original package on an emulated chip and ask more of the device. Search reads the name, the author and the description. Opening a .fwsc loads a package of your own. A firmware that stops is restarted with Restart.
exact.Certains firmwares ajoutent un bouton so: Some firmwares add a button under the FM-1: Import a DX7 sound with FM-1+VA, Samples with Pigeon and zp12. Their functions panel explains it.
exact.Les six coloris du FM-1, en pastilles so: The six FM-1 colourways, as swatches under the FM-1. With FM-1+VA, the screen takes the matching theme.
exact.Solo et Duo, en haut de la page. Deux FM: Solo and Duo, at the top of the page. Two FM-1s at once, FM1-A and FM1-B, each with its own firmware, memory and power: one above the other in portrait, one or the other in landscape, side by side if you like on a large screen. Linked tempo: an FM-1+VA leads (FM1-A if there is one), the other follows its clock and starts with it; a native or emulated firmware receives it too, and follows it if it can follow a MIDI clock (emulated Felucca family: CLK on TRS). FM1-B takes FM-1+VA or a native firmware.
exact.Quand le navigateur gère le MIDI, le bou: When the browser handles MIDI, the MIDI button picks the input and the channel, for all firmwares and for this FM-1 only; its light blinks when messages arrive. A connected MIDI keyboard plays the loaded firmware.
exact.Le bouton en haut à droite. Là où le nav: The button at the top right. Where the browser does not allow it (iPhone), adding the page to the Home Screen, with Share then Add to Home Screen, opens it without a toolbar.
exact.Les presets, patterns et réglages de cha: The presets, patterns and settings of each firmware, the last firmware chosen, the colourway and the MIDI choice, in this browser only. Powering off erases those of the active firmware; with FM-1+VA, the colourway also returns to Mint.
exact.FM-1+VA n'est pas le code de Baud Girl :: FM-1+VA is not Baud Girl's code: its compiled firmware only runs on the FM-1's JieLi chip. Everything is rewritten from the FM-1+VA manual. The panel comes from the DUB-1 emulator, under the GPL-3.0 licence, like this page. The emulated firmwares run on Joakim Eriksson's fm1-emu core, under the MIT licence. Each firmware keeps its own licence, recalled in its functions panel; the texts are in the repository's firmwares/licences folder.
exact.Il joue dès que la page a le focus, FM-1: It plays as soon as the page has focus, with the FM-1 powered on; a field or a button on the page keeps its own keys. What counts is the position of the keys: the piano stays a piano on an AZERTY keyboard.
exact.Glisser vers le haut ou la droite, ou la: Drag up or to the right, or use the mouse wheel. Slowly, one notch changes the value by one unit; faster, the step accelerates. <kbd>Shift</kbd> keeps a step of one unit, with the mouse as with the keyboard.
exact.Maj+clic ou clic droit garde un bouton e: Shift+click or right-click holds a button down. On a finger, hold with one hand and turn with the other.
Click or finger, several at once.
exact.Tournez le téléphone pour des commandes: Turn the phone for larger controls.
exact.L'entrée MIDI et son canal, pour tous le: The MIDI input and its channel, for all firmwares
exact.Les firmwares émulés reçoivent tout, hor: Emulated firmwares receive everything, clock included: Felucca and its relatives follow it with CLK on TRS. This choice applies to this FM-1 only.
exact.Un fichier .syx de Yamaha DX7 (un son ou: A Yamaha DX7 .syx file (one sound or a bank of 32), taken from Files: on the iPad or in iCloud Drive
exact.Un son long devient la chanson, les sons: A long sound becomes the song, short sounds the pads (16 at most); or a .kob bank.
exact.Votre ROM LSDj ou DMGo! (.gb) : aucune n: Your LSDj or DMGo! ROM (.gb): none is supplied here. It is checked, then kept in this browser.
exact.Des sons sur les pads C1 à D8 (16 au plu: Sounds on pads C1 to D8 (16 at most); zp12 keeps them, EDIT > WAVE moves them to another pad.
exact.Marche / arrêt. Éteindre efface les régl: Power. Turning off erases the settings of the active firmware.
exact.Le tempo se lie quand les deux FM-1 sont: The tempo links when both FM-1s are on and one plays FM-1+VA: it gives the clock. Native firmwares do not send one.
exact.Le firmware de Baud Girl réécrit d'après: Baud Girl's firmware rewritten from its manual: six-operator FM, Virtual Analog and 8-Bit.
exact.· Rédigée d'après le code du firmware, f: · Written from the firmware's code, for lack of documentation.
exact.Pas de fiche pour ce firmware pour l'ins: No sheet for this firmware yet.
exact.Allumez le FM-1 avant de charger un fich: Power on the FM-1 before loading a DX7 file.
exact.Banque DX7 de 32 patches : répondez à la: DX7 bank of 32 patches: answer the question on the screen (ALGORITHM picks the bank).
exact.En Duo, FM1-B prend FM-1+VA ou un firmwa: In Duo, FM1-B takes FM-1+VA or a native firmware.
exact.FMDj : chargez votre ROM LSDj ou DMGo! (: FMDj: load your LSDj or DMGo! ROM (.gb) with "ROM…".
exact.Ce navigateur n'ouvre pas le plein écran: This browser cannot open full screen. Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen: opened from the Home Screen, the FM-1 fills the whole screen.
